Class ModConfig

java.lang.Object
com.happyuky7.openvoxelmoding.loader.ModConfig
public final class ModConfig extends Object
Persistent key/value settings for one mod, stored as a properties file at instance/config/<modId>.properties. Obtain it with ModContext.config(String). 
ModConfig cfg = ctx.config("mymod");
boolean hud = cfg.getBoolean("hud.enabled", true);
cfg.set("hud.enabled", !hud).save();
Values are strings on disk; the typed getters fall back to the default when a value is missing or cannot be parsed. Every config is also saved automatically when the game closes.
